name: HTML
description: I use HTML5 as the structural backbone of every project, focusing on semantic elements for accessibility, SEO, and maintainability. I ensure proper document hierarchy, optimized media handling, and clean, readable markup that integrates seamlessly with modern frameworks.

name: CSS
description: I design responsive and scalable interfaces using modern CSS techniques like Flexbox, Grid, and custom properties. I focus on performance, reusability, and consistency, often combining CSS with utility-first approaches for rapid UI development.

name: React
description: I build dynamic, component-driven interfaces with React, focusing on reusable logic through hooks and clean state management. I emphasize predictable data flow and performance-conscious rendering to keep applications fast as they scale.

name: Next.js
description: I use Next.js to build production-ready full-stack applications, leveraging server-side rendering, routing, and API routes to deliver fast, SEO-friendly experiences. I focus on structuring apps for scalability and maintainability from the start.

name: Node.js
description: I use Node.js to build efficient, event-driven backend systems, handling asynchronous operations and server logic with a focus on performance and reliability under real-world load.

name: Express.js
description: I structure RESTful APIs and backend architecture with Express.js, emphasizing clean routing, middleware design, and secure, maintainable server logic.

name: MongoDB
description: I design flexible, scalable data models with MongoDB, focusing on efficient schema design and query performance to support real-world application needs.

name: better-auth
description: I implement secure, modern authentication flows using better-auth, focusing on reliable session handling and a smooth, frictionless login experience for users.

name: Vercel
description: I deploy and manage full-stack applications on Vercel, taking advantage of its seamless CI/CD pipeline and edge infrastructure to ship fast, reliable production builds.

name: Vite
description: I use Vite for rapid local development, relying on its fast HMR and optimized build process to keep the development feedback loop tight.

name: VS Code
description: I rely on VS Code as my primary development environment, customizing it with extensions and workflows that keep my coding process efficient and organized.
